description: The formerly forwarded `tensor_p` keyword now collides with the explicit keyword.
trigger: Call `model_init.init(args, tensor_p=False)` using an otherwise valid namespace with the new attribute.
expected_behavior: Forward `False` to the loader as before through the documented extra keywords.
actual_behavior: Python raises `TypeError` for multiple values for `tensor_p` before the loader runs, even when both values are false.

verification.description: Exercised the explicit keyword plus `**kwargs` call with the same key in both.
verification.limits: No in-tree caller passing this keyword through `init` was found.

introductions.rationale: Adds explicit tensor_p forwarding while retaining the general keyword expansion.
